title: barse: flashcard versions and a final pick

steps.title: The whole change
steps.note:
This range teaches barse to keep **every generated version** of a lesson's flashcards and lets the teacher pick the *final* one.

Yellow packages changed, green ones are new. The arcs are imports and calls that changed between packages.

steps.title: The generator package
steps.note:
`service/flashcard/generator` carries most of the change: versions are listed, regenerated from a chosen source, and their phases are reported to the UI.

The arcs out of it go to `db`, where the new queries live.

steps.title: From the final-pick handler to the new version bar
steps.note: `handlePostSelectFinal` re-renders the lesson body. That walk ends in `versionBar`, the new strip of version tabs on the lesson page.

steps.title: Picking the final version
steps.note: `review.Service.SelectFinal` is new. It refuses once the lesson is published, checks the run finished, then marks it final.

steps.title: Where "final" is stored
steps.note:
Two new queries hold the flag, and `generator.FinalVersion` reads it back.

- `Queries.SetGenerationFinal`
- `Queries.ClearGenerationFinal`
- `generator.FinalVersion`

steps.title: The generation run changed
steps.note: `runGeneration` now records each phase so the lesson page can show progress per version.

steps.title: The lesson page
steps.note: `meetings/view` gained a version bar, version tabs and the published notice.

steps.title: Back to the plain city
steps.note: That is the whole change. Press **space** to replay, or use the roadmap to jump back.
